title: Safe Meta-Reinforcement Learning via Information Space Reachability
abstract: arXiv:2609.15915v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Meta-reinforcement learning (meta-RL) enables agents to adapt to unseen tasks with limited experience. Despite its promise, the application of meta-RL in real-world tasks is hindered by safety requirements, which have been underexplored in prior work. In this paper, we propose a safe meta-RL framework that explicitly accounts for safety during adaptation. Our key insight is to reason about safety in the information space, which captures both the physical state and the agent's belief over the underlying task. Within this space, we introduce a safety value function that measures the probability of the agent avoiding unsafe regions indefinitely. We show that this function satisfies a self-consistency condition and a Bellman equation, which make it learnable via meta-RL. Based on this formulation, we develop a safe meta-RL algorithm that learns the safety value function and leverages it for safety filtering and constrained policy optimizatio

translated_title: 基于信息空间可达性的安全元强化学习
translated_abstract: 元强化学习使智能体能够以有限的经验适应未见过的任务。尽管前景广阔，但元强化学习在现实世界任务中的应用受到安全需求的阻碍，而这一问题在以往工作中尚未得到充分探索。在本文中，我们提出了一个在适应过程中显式考虑安全性的安全元强化学习框架。我们的关键洞察是在信息空间中对安全性进行推理，该空间同时捕捉了物理状态和智能体对底层任务的信念。在该空间中，我们引入了一个安全价值函数，用于度量智能体无限期避开不安全区域的概率。我们证明该函数满足一个自洽性条件和贝尔曼方程，这使其可以通过元强化学习进行学习。基于这一公式化框架，我们开发了一种安全元强化学习算法，该算法学习安全价值函数，并将其用于安全过滤和约束策略优化。
tldr: 提出了一个在信息空间中推理安全性的安全元强化学习框架，通过引入可学习的安全价值函数来度量智能体无限期避开不安全区域的概率，并将其用于安全过滤和约束策略优化。
